description_sq:
Shesim apartament 1+1 ne Rrugen Fortuzi.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje pallat te mireadministruar me ashensor.
Ndodhet ne katin e 8 jo te fundit.
I rikonstruktuar se fundmi dhe i organizuar ne:
- Korridor Shperndares
- Sallon me kuzhine
- Dhome gjumi
- Tualet
- Ballkon
Ne nje nga zonat me qendrore te Tiranes vetem 10 minuta larg qendres se qytetit.
Mund te sherbej per nje jetese komode ose per dhenie me qira.
Per nje vizite ne prone, me kontaktoni.
description_en: We are selling a 1+1 apartment on Fortuzi Street. The apartment is located in a well-managed building with an elevator. It is located on the 8th floor, not the last. Recently reconstructed and organized in: - Distribution Corridor - Living room with kitchen - Bedroom - Toilet - Balcony In one of the most central areas of Tirana, only 10 minutes from the city center. I can serve for a comfortable living or for renting. For a visit to the property, contact me.
